Rashi on Bava Metzia 71a:10:1.english: Sold for idol worship - To chop wood and to draw water.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 71a:11:1.hebrew: אמר מר - השתא מפרש מאי קשיא ליה, דקאמר איני יודע מהו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 71a:11:1.english: The Master said - Now [the Gemara] explains what was difficult for him, that he said, "I do not know what it is."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 71a:12:1.english: Not proper conduct - for he is secluded with her.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 71a:12:2.hebrew: גמירי דמיקני קני - הנקנה בעבד עברי, קונה בעבד עברי:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 71a:12:2.english: It is learned [as a tradition that] one who can be acquired can acquire - One who can be acquired as a Hebrew slave can acquire a Hebrew slave.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 71a:14:1.english: As it is taught - That there is a distinction between one sold to a gentile and one sold to a Jew.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 71a:14:2.english: One who had his ear pierced - [This refers to] a Hebrew slave [who was sold] to a Jew, and the master died before the Jubilee.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 71a:14:3.hebrew: אינו עובד לא את הבן ולא את הבת - שנאמר (שמות כ״א:ו׳) ועבדו לעולם, ולא לבן:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 71a:14:3.english: [He] does not serve the son or the daughter - As it is stated (Exodus 21:6): "And he shall serve him forever" — and not the son.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 71a:14:4.hebrew: והנמכר לנכרי - ילפינן בקדושין (דף יז:): "וחשב עם קונהו" — ולא עם יורשי קונהו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 71a:14:4.english: And [one] who was sold to a gentile - We derive [this] in Kiddushin (17b) [from the verse]: "And he shall reckon with his purchaser" [Leviticus 25:50] — and not with the heirs of his purchaser.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 71a:16:1.hebrew: צניע לה - מוחזק צנוע הוא בעיניה, שאם יקלקלו יחד, לא יתפאר לגלות הדבר. הלכך, אסור לקנותו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 71a:16:1.english: Discreet to her - He is presumed discreet in her eyes, for if they act immorally together, he will not boast to reveal the matter. Therefore, it is forbidden to acquire him.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 71a:16:2.english: Indiscreet to her - And she is afraid to abandon herself to him.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 71a:17:1.english: She may not raise a dog - She may not raise a dog, lest she act immorally [by engaging in bestiality] with it.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 71a:17:2.english: He is discreet for her - And she is confident that [it] will not become known.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 71a:17:3.english: Since it clings [to her] closely, she is afraid - to be mounted by it.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 71a:18:1.english: Ger toshav - [One] who accepted upon himself not to worship idols, and eats carrion [neveilot].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 71a:18:2.hebrew: אל תקח מאתו כתיב - אאחיך קאי. וכי כתיב גר תושב, לענין וחי עמך כתיב, שאתה מצווה להחיותו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 71a:18:2.english: It is written: "You may not take [interest] from him" - This refers to "your brother"; and when "a stranger and a resident" is written, it is written with respect to "shall he live with you," [meaning] that you are commanded to sustain him.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 71a:1:1.hebrew: בכדי חייו - התירו לו, ויותר מכאן אסור מדרבנן, דלמא אתי למיסרך:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 71a:1:1.english: To the extent of his livelihood - They permitted [it] to him, but more than that is prohibited by rabbinic decree, lest he come to become accustomed [to taking interest].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 71a:20:1.english: But you may become a guarantor for him - The borrower's guarantor toward the lender.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 71a:2:1.hebrew: רבינא אמר - מתניתין דקתני מלוין אותן ברבית, בתלמיד חכם עסקינן:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 71a:2:1.english: Ravina said - [Regarding] our Mishnah, which teaches "one may lend to them with interest," we are dealing with a Torah scholar.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 71a:2:2.hebrew: טעמא מאי אמרו רבנן - רבית נכרי אסור? שמא ירגיל הנכרי אצלו וילמד ממעשיו. לא גרסינן "דלמא אתי למיסרך":
Rashi on Bava Metzia 71a:2:2.english: What is the reason the Sages said - [that] interest [from] a gentile is forbidden? Lest the gentile become accustomed [to visiting] him and he learn from his actions. We do not read: "lest he come to be drawn [after him]."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 71a:3:1.english: If you lend money to My people - [If] My people and a gentile come to borrow, My people takes precedence.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 71a:3:2.english: Your poor and the poor of your city - Poor people who are relatives and from your family.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 71a:3:3.english: Your poor take precedence - For it is written "with you." [This refers to] those who are close to you.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 71a:3:4.english: The poor of your city take precedence over the poor of another city - For these are “with you” more.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 71a:5:1.hebrew: יורד עמו לחייו - רגיל להתקוטט עמו, כאילו הכהו וכאילו בא להורגו. ואני שמעתי: רשאי לירד לתוך אומנותו של חבירו ולמעט מזונותיו של חבירו. וקשה בעיני שיתירו חכמים לישראל להנקם ולגמול רעה. ועוד, דאמרי' בכתובות (דף נ.): עד שתים עשרה שנה מתגלגל אדם עם בנו, מכאן ואילך יורד עמו לחייו. ומאי יורד לתוך אומנותו איכא? הא לייסרו ולכופו לתורה קאמר:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 71a:5:1.english: He goes down with him to his life - [This means] he is accustomed to quarrel with him, as though he had struck him and as though he had come to kill him. However, I have heard [another explanation, that] he is permitted to enter into his fellow's trade and diminish his fellow's livelihood. But it is difficult in my eyes that the Sages would permit a Jew to take vengeance and repay evil. Furthermore, we say in Ketubot (50a): "Up to twelve years, a person deals patiently with his son; from then on, he goes down with him to his life." Now, what "entering into his trade" is there [in that case]? Surely it means to chastise him and compel him to [study] Torah!

Rashi on Bava Metzia 71a:5:2.english: So-and-so denied - [in] that he lent [to] a Jew with interest.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 71a:6:1.hebrew: מתמוטטים - דוק הכי: "עושה אלה לא ימוט", הא אם נתן בנשך, ימוט:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 71a:6:1.english: Collapse - Infer [it] thus: "He who does these shall not collapse"; thus, if he has given [his money] with interest, he will collapse.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 71a:6:2.hebrew: הללו מתמוטטין ועולין והללו וכו' - והכי משמע קרא: "כל עושה אלה לא ימוט לעולם", כלומר, ואם ימוט, אין מוטתו מוטת עולם; אבל הנותן בנשך ימוט לעולם:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 71a:6:2.english: Those collapse and rise, and these, etc. - And this is what the verse means: "Whoever does these shall never collapse," that is to say, [even] if he collapses, his collapse is not a permanent collapse; whereas one who gives [money] with interest will collapse permanently.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 71a:7:1.hebrew: צדיק גמור אינו בולע - ואע"פ שמתמוטט, עולה ואינו נבלע לעולם:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 71a:7:1.english: He does not swallow a completely righteous person - And even though he collapses, he rises and is never swallowed.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 71a:9:1.hebrew: ולא לך אלא לגר - לעיל קאי, ורישא דברייתא במסכת ערכין (דף ל:): בא וראה כמה קשה אבקה של שביעית, אדם נושא ונותן בפירות שביעית, סוף מוכר מטלטליו כו' עד לא באת לידו עד שמוכר עצמו, שנאמר: ונמכר לך, ולא לך אלא לגר:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 71a:9:1.english: And not [only] to you, but [even] to a convert - This refers to [what was stated] above, and the beginning of the baraita [is found] in Tractate Arakhin (30b): "Come and see how severe is the dust [i.e., secondary prohibitions] of the Sabbatical year: a person transacts business with Sabbatical-year produce, [and] eventually he sells his movable property, etc.," until [it states]: "[It] does not come into his hand until he sells himself, as it is stated: 'and is sold to you' — and not [only] to you, but [even] to a convert."

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 71a:10:1.hebrew: או לעקר זה הנמכר לעבודת כוכבים עצמה - וא"ת: למ"ל למכתב בתר "עקר" "משפחת גר", דהיינו נכרי? כיון דנמכר לעבודת כוכבים, א"כ נמכר לנכרי! וי"ל: דה"א לעבודת כוכבים של ישראל, כגון פסלו של מיכה. א"נ, אי לאו דכתיב "משפחת גר", ה"א דעקר היינו נכרי. אבל אין לתרץ דאצטריך משום גאולת קרובים, דמגר תושב נפיק — כ"ש נכרי:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 71a:10:1.english: "Or to an offshoot" — this is one sold for idol worship itself - And if you will say: Why did [Scripture] need to write after "offshoot" [the phrase] "a stranger's family," which is a gentile? Since he is sold for idol worship, if so, he is sold to a gentile! And one can answer: One might have thought [that "offshoot" refers] to idol worship of an Israelite, such as the idol of Micah. Alternatively, if "a stranger's family" were not written, one might have thought that "offshoot" means a gentile. However, one cannot answer that [the phrase "a stranger's family"] is needed because of redemption by relatives, for [that] is already derived from "a resident alien [ger toshav]" — all the more so [when sold to] a gentile.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 71a:14:1.hebrew: אינו עובד לא את הבן ולא את הבת - אגב בן נקט בת, דאפילו נמכר לישראל אינו עובד את הבת:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 71a:14:1.english: [He] does not serve either the son or the daughter - Because of "the son," [the Tanna] mentioned "the daughter," for even [one who was] sold to an Israelite does not serve the daughter.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 71a:17:1.hebrew: לא תרבי כלבא - משום לזות שפתים בעלמא, לפי שהולך אחריה; שלא נחשדו ישראל על הזכור ועל הבהמה, וגם אין אסור להתייחד:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 71a:17:1.english: "She may not raise a dog" - [This is] merely because of slander, since it follows after her; for Jews are not suspected of [lying with] a male or an animal, and furthermore it is not forbidden to be secluded [with an animal].

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 71a:5:1.hebrew: אדם קורא לחבירו רשע יורד עמו לחייו - כתוב בתשובות הגאונים בשם רב צדוק גאון: "יורד עמו לחייו" — רשאי לשרוף שליש תבואתו. ותימה גדול מנין לו זה:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 71a:5:1.english: A person calls another "wicked," he descends with him to his life - It is written in the Responsa of the Geonim in the name of Rav Tzadok Gaon: "He descends with him to his life" — he is permitted to burn a third of his produce. And it is a great wonder from where he [derived] this:

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 71a:6:1.hebrew: הא חזינן דלא עבדי הכי ומתמוטטים - וא"ת: דלמא משום שאר עבירות הכתובים באותו פסוק, "ושוחד על נקי לא לקח"? וי"ל: דפריך דחזינן צדיקים גמורים נמי מתמוטטין. א"נ: לר"ע פריך, דדריש בסוף מכות (דף כד. ע"ש): "עושה אלה" — עושה אחת מכל אלה לא ימוט:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 71a:6:1.english: "But we see [people] who do not do so and [yet] collapse" - And if you ask: Perhaps [their property collapses] because of the other transgressions written in that same verse, [such as] "and who has not taken a bribe against the innocent"? One can answer: [The Gemara] is asking because we see completely righteous people collapsing as well. Alternatively: It is asking according to Rabbi Akiva, who expounds at the end of Makkot (24a, see there): "[He who does] these" — [even] one who does one of all these shall not collapse.
